author: TED
description: We see consciousness in AI the same way we see faces in clouds, says neuroscientist Anil Seth. He explores the all-too-human tendency to project inner life onto machines that are brilliant mimics, not sentient beings, and gives a definitive answer to the urgent question: Will AI ever gain consciousness?
title: Many experts think conscious AI is an inevitability. Neuroscientist Anil Seth thinks they’re wrong.
